mappings.note: Whom Ambedkar urged into government service (Dalits) -> C-SST6.1-LO-2, which names Scheduled Castes; not C-SST5.1-LO-2, since no Fundamental Right is being illustrated.
India's first Health Minister; a Union office, which no LO covers -> goal-level.
First Prime Minister (duplicate of qid:110799) -> goal-level.
When the Constitution was completed; constitution-making chronology -> goal-level.
President of the Constituent Assembly -> goal-level, constitution-making.
Elected representatives belong to the legislature; naming an organ of the state -> goal-level. Not C-SST5.2-LO-2, which is about how the election is conducted.
Equality before law belongs to the Right to Equality -> C-SST5.1-LO-2, illustrating a Fundamental Right.
What a nation's constitution contains; the nature of a constitution -> goal-level.
Definition of an ideal, the chapter's term for a constitutional aspiration -> goal-level; no LO covers the vocabulary.
When Nepal's king took over as head of government; the comparative case for why a constitution matters -> goal-level.
Who forms the government under universal adult suffrage -> C-SST5.2-LO-2, the election process.
The citizen's role in electing representatives -> C-SST5.2-LO-2.
The term for an independent people in a democracy (sovereign); a Preamble term -> goal-level, since no LO covers the Preamble.
A 13-year-old working in a factory is child labour -> C-SST6.1-LO-1, which names Child Rights as its worked example.
Identifying the Fundamental Rights -> C-SST5.1-LO-2 directly.
What secularism commits the state to; a constitutional principle rather than a named Fundamental Right -> goal-level.
What a constitution is, defined as the rules governing a country -> goal-level.
Features of a parliamentary form of government -> goal-level; C-SST5.2-LO-1 is about the State/Union split, not the form of government.
Which prohibition the Right against Exploitation does not carry -> C-SST5.1-LO-2, illustrating the limits of a Fundamental Right.
Equality before law again, asked from the other direction -> C-SST5.1-LO-2.
The 'conscience' of the Constitution is its Fundamental Rights (with the Directive Principles) -> C-SST5.1-LO-2, the rights outcome.
Meaning of a republican form of government; a Preamble term -> goal-level.
